text:
Sara (CSM): Quick heads-up — ACME Retail is showing renewal risk. Usage down ~45% over last 30d, onboarding tasks 'model pinning' and 'evals' still open. Renewal in 28 days. Need a short, actionable save plan we can execute this week. :warning:
Miguel (CSM): Yikes. Do we have session logs / top error types? Could be perf or feature mismatch. :eyes:
Sara (CSM): Main issues from notes: slow responses on long prompts, customers tried quantized variant and saw hallucinations. Also they expected autoscaling on spikes (we didn't enable burst for Dedicated eval).
Jordan A. (AE): I'll take ownership of the outreach. Suggest we offer a 30-day dedicated trial + 2 enablement sessions, and a rollback safety path if quality dips. Samie, would product be ok with a temporary credit?
Samie (PM): We can approve $6k credits for a short trial if it comes with a structured success plan. Also product wants logs + example prompts to triage hallucination.
Miguel (CSM): Here's a condensed save checklist I recommend we follow this week:
```
- Day 0: Outreach + kickoff call (owner: Jordan)
- Day 1-3: Enablement session #1 (model tuning + evals) (owner: Miguel)
- Day 4-7: Apply config: enable burst capacity, adjust quantization profile (engineers looped)
- Day 8-12: Run targeted evals on their 10 canonical prompts, capture diffs
- Week 2: Enablement session #2 + share ROI dashboard; present credit term + renewal recommendation
- Fallback: If regression >5% on evals, auto-roll back quant profile and open incident runbook
```
Sara (CSM): Copy of quick metrics snapshot I pulled:
```
Monthly usage: 420k tokens (prev month: 760k)
Active seats: 8 (goal: 15)
Open onboarding tasks: 3 (model pinning, evals, api-key rotation)
Top errors: KV cache timeouts 2.3% of calls, 15% slower p95 for >1024 tokens
```
Jordan A. (AE): Draft outreach script — can someone sanity-check?
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We noticed a drop in usage and want to ensure you hit your goals. Can we schedule a 30-min call this week to offer a short Dedicated trial + hands-on tuning to address quality and latency? We'll share concrete evals and a rollback safety plan.
```
Miguel (CSM): LGTM. I'll prepare the eval harness and sample prompt set. Can OpsBot create the calendar block and tag product engineers?
OpsBot: Created tentative calendar for 1766620000 with tags: #enablement #product-eng. Invite sent to: Jordan A., Miguel, Sara, Samie. :white_check_mark:
Samie (PM): I'll loop in EngRuntime for the quant profile tweak. Miguel, attach the 10 canonical prompts to the invite so Eng has context.
Sara (CSM): Volunteers for on-call during the trial window? Need someone to monitor cost spikes and quality regressions.
Jordan A. (AE): I can monitor daily and ping Eng if evals break threshold. :thumbsup:
Miguel (CSM): I'll run the first enablement session and collect feedback for the product team.
Samie (PM): Also capture qualitative feedback (why they didn't finish onboarding). Short survey: 3 questions post-kickoff. I can draft.
Sara (CSM): Perfect — I'll book the kickoff and send the trial offer + credit terms after the call. Thanks team. :pray:
